testRegistry.title: UI experience registry
testRegistry.description: Safe, reusable previews of real GainForest flows, powered by mock data and blocked side effects.
testRegistry.availableDescription: Choose a flow to open its safe, fully interactive preview.
testRegistry.parityBody: Developers and AI agents: every experience here must render the production component itself. Mock only data and side effects—never copy or fork the interface. Any UI or UX change must affect the mock and live experience in the same way.
testRegistry.indexingNote: This route is public but excluded from search engines. Never place secrets or real personal data here.
testRegistry.experienceDescription: Walk through the current production donation experience with safe fixture data and no real payment.
testRegistry.projectPromptBody: Choose an amount, review the cart, connect the simulated wallet, and complete a safe preview payment.
testRegistry.mockProjectDescription: Restoring a living corridor between community forests and protected habitat.

projectVisibility.title: Project visibility card
projectVisibility.description: The card on Manage → Projects that tells an account what is public and whether it shows on the explore pages, in each state it can be in.
projectVisibility.mockNote: Listing an account on the explore pages is a real side effect, so this preview never performs one. Only the card's two server calls are replaced by fixtures.
projectVisibility.cardDescription: See how the projects page reports what is public and what listing on the explore pages changes.

unlisted.label: Owner · not on the explore pages
unlisted.body: The account can add itself to the explore lists.

listed.label: Owner · on the explore pages
listed.body: Already listed, so no action is offered.

member.label: Member · not on the explore pages
member.body: Members see where the account stands, but cannot change it.

unavailable.label: Listing cannot be changed right now
unavailable.body: The status still shows; the button is left out instead of being rendered dead.

unknown.label: Listing status could not be read
unknown.body: The card says so rather than claiming the account is not listed.

bioblitzNotifications.title: BioBlitz winner email states
bioblitzNotifications.description: The production moderator status rows for winner emails, including missing account email and manual follow-up.
bioblitzNotifications.mockNote: All winners are fixtures. Marking a row handled changes memory only and never writes an award or notification.
bioblitzNotifications.cardDescription: Preview every moderator-facing delivery and manual-contact state.

invitationDelivery.title: Invitation delivery states
invitationDelivery.description: The production pending-invitation row for sent, delayed, manual-link, and role-restricted email states.
invitationDelivery.mockNote: All addresses are fixtures. Retry, copy, and cancel update memory only and never call a live service.
invitationDelivery.cardDescription: Preview delivery status, safe retry, copy-link, and cancel actions for organization invitations.
invitationDelivery.mockRetried: Mock retry completed without sending an email.
invitationDelivery.mockCopied: Mock invitation link copied without using the clipboard.
invitationDelivery.mockCanceled: Mock invitation removed from this preview.

testRegistry.myCardsDescription: Preview the collected Bumicerts gallery, populated with sample collectibles.

rewildingMilestones.title: Rewilding grant milestones
rewildingMilestones.description: The grantee's read-only milestone list next to the admin checklist that confirms them.
rewildingMilestones.mockNote: The grantee and the grant are fixtures. Confirming a milestone, uploading a document, or opening one changes memory only — nothing is saved, uploaded, or linked.
rewildingMilestones.cardDescription: Compare what a grantee sees with what an admin can confirm.
rewildingMilestones.granteeDescription: Read-only. A grantee cannot mark a milestone done — the row only shows whether GainForest confirmed it.
rewildingMilestones.adminDescription: The same milestones, with the confirm and reopen controls, plus the private grant documents.
rewildingMilestones.openedNote: In the real panel this would open “{title}” through a link that expires in minutes.

myCards.description: Every Bumicert comes from a verified project donation receipt linked to your account.
myCards.emptyBody: Donate to a project while signed in and showing your name to earn your first Bumicert.
myCards.signedOutTitle: Sign in to see your Bumicerts
myCards.signedOutBody: Bumicerts are linked to your account so they stay available across browsers and devices.
myCards.unavailableBody: Your donation records are safe. Please try loading your Bumicerts again.
myCards.partialBody: Some donation records or project details could not be loaded. The Bumicerts shown here are verified, but your collection may be incomplete.
